posts.headline: Forty-one editions and counting — Thicks' Klint's Clipboard sits 5-2 but that ring is still a relic when 839.22 points-for ranks him near the bottom of winning teams.
posts.detail: A title from two seasons ago bought Tyrique14 zero slack; a career 14-14 record and 5.5 average finish says this 'contender' is coasting on a record win total with middling production.

posts.headline: Shake N Bakers lead the league in scoring at 957.96 and triciagloston just won't stop proving the doubters wrong.
posts.detail: Sitting 5-2 with a career 6-7-1 mark that undersold her, she's now outscoring the entire league including the self-proclaimed contenders — the quiet dominance bit keeps aging well.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's Put it in Ra falls further to 2-5 and the league's best-ever 1.5 average finish is now just a ghost story.
posts.detail: A 20-8 career record and back-to-back top-2 finishes built a dynasty narrative that 806.46 points and a sub-.500 record this year is actively torching.

posts.headline: BIBLE OR THE BELT hits twenty straight editions of futility, still winless at 0-7, and Eli's Ultimate Light Skin is running out of commandments to break.
posts.detail: A career 13-14-1 record was merely mediocre before — now 0-7 with 731.92 points makes this the worst stretch of his two-season tenure, belt fully chosen.

posts.headline: Sasinci stays stuck at 3-4 and Big Head's title defense keeps bleeding out with no signs of a pulse.
posts.detail: One ring and a career 5.5 average finish promised a real contender, but 814.86 points and a losing record have the Milk Man singing a much sadder tune than usual.
